issue.title: Bug: Download start ignores Wi‑Fi/cellular gate that blocks Sync Now
issue.body:
## Summary

Upload and download use different transport gates, so a user can successfully start resource downloads while Sync Now is blocked (or looks broken) on the same device.

Confirmed from `origin/main` while investigating Chad’s report (downloads worked; Sync Now did nothing).

### Confirmed asymmetry

| Path | Gate |
| --- | --- |
| Sync Now / upload orchestrator | Requires `isWifi` **or** `uploadOverCellular` (`transportAllowsUpload`). Sync UI disables Sync Now when `cellularBlocked`. |
| Download queue **`start()`** | **No** Wi‑Fi / cellular preference check (`useDownloadQueue.start`). |
| Download **`resume()`** / auto-resume | Requires `isOnline && isWifi` only — does **not** honor `uploadOverCellular`. |

NetInfo treats only `type === 'wifi'` as Wi‑Fi (`connectivity.ts`). Non-wifi online types (`ethernet`, `cellular`, `other`) share the upload “waiting for Wi‑Fi” path unless the cellular toggle is on.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Document and implement one transport policy for upload + download (product call: Wi‑Fi-only vs cellular toggle applies to both).
- [ ] Download `start`, `resume`, and auto-resume use that same policy (today `start` is ungated; `resume` ignores the cellular toggle).
- [ ] If Sync Now is blocked by transport while downloads are allowed (or vice versa), Sync / Prepare-for-Offline copy explains why.
- [ ] Unit tests for the shared gate helper covering wifi / cellular+toggle / ethernet-like non-wifi / offline.

## Out of scope

- Sync Now silent no-op when pending queries disagree (separate ticket).
- Surfacing `upload_error` (separate ticket).

## Related

- Code: `src/services/uploadOrchestratorCore.ts` (`transportAllowsUpload`), `src/app/screens/SyncScreen.tsx` (`cellularBlocked`), `src/hooks/useDownloadQueue.ts` (`start` vs `resume`), `src/services/downloadQueueAutoResume.ts`, `src/services/connectivity.ts`.
- Slack: Chad White, #fluent-mobile-team, 2026-09-17.

comments.body:
**Gap found during the #529 audit (Going offline, epic #526): Gap 6 — "Download 'starts' with a blocked transport and gives no feedback"**

While verifying the going offline feature, the audit found this gap. **This issue closes Gap 6**, and the fix is in progress in PR #559. No separate issue was filed for it.

Device: Xiaomi Redmi Note 9 Pro, Android 10 (API 29), nightly `1.0.0` of `main` @ `d5b9e64` (G.31 on a local debug build of the same commit), `dev.api.fluent.bible`.

What the device showed:

- **E.18:** Wi-Fi off, mobile data working, "Upload/Download over cellular" off. On the first entry to Prepare for Offline (no earlier Pause), Download is enabled. Tapping it shows Pause + Cancel with no progress and no explanation for about 30 s. When Wi-Fi returns, the download continues on its own.
- **G.31:** in airplane mode, Prepare for Offline renders the chapters and resources. Download is enabled; tapping it shows Pause + Cancel with no message, and the log shows `DownloadQueueWorker` "Failed to download item".

Code cause on `main`: download `start` has no transport check (`src/hooks/useDownloadQueue.ts:243-268`), while `resume` and auto-resume require Wi-Fi and ignore the cellular toggle (`src/hooks/useDownloadQueue.ts:284-293`, `src/services/downloadQueueAutoResume.ts:13`).

Suggested additional AC for this issue:

- [ ] With the shared policy returning `offline` or `waiting_wifi`, Download does not show Pause + Cancel as if it were transferring; the Prepare for Offline screen explains why the download waits (E.18, G.31).

After PR #559 merges, the audit re-tests A.1–A.3, E.17–E.19, F.20, G.22, G.28 and G.31 on the new `main`. E.19 (an in-flight download pausing when Wi-Fi drops) has no open issue, since #572 was closed without a fix. If it still fails after #559, it becomes a new gap under #146.

Assessment: `docs/assessments/going-offline/` (PR #577).
